Name: A Wittily Named Recolor
Author: acerbicon
Description:
[b] [/b][center][b][size=3]A Wittily Named Recolor[/size][/b]
[size=2]Have you ever felt like the whole game, though beautiful, needed a new coat of paint?
Well, apparently [/size][size=2]some people have because a number of people have shown interest in the one
I made [/size][size=2]for myself. So for all of those who are interested, this is for you![/size]


[size=3][b]REQUIREMENTS[/b]: [/size]
[url=http://www.smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][size=2]﻿[/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][size=2]﻿[/size]


[b][size=3]INSTALLATION:[/size][/b]
[size=2]1. Download the .zip file.[/size]
[size=2]2. Unzip into the "Mods" folder.[/size]
[size=2]3. Play the game with its new paint job.

[b][size=3]CREDITS:
[/size][/b]1. The stone fencing in the fall/spring/summer/winter_outdoorsTileSheet
files is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3235]Overgrown Stone Fence[/url]﻿ by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/63665361]zipprus[/url]﻿

[b]EXTRA INFO:[/b]
Should be compatible with all languages. If there are any errors in languages other than English, please
post this in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2995?tab=bugs]BUGS[/url]﻿ tab.
[/size][/center]

Downloads.Description: Compatibility to recolor the waterfalls to my colors. Replace your SEASON_z_extras files with the ones included. Also includes an overlay for updating the files should SVE's SEASON_z_extras tileset get updated since I'm not updating this file.

Beta update for 1.5

Changed the wooden fence around the farm, town, etc to Zipprus' Overgrown Stone Fence. Added a second new mushroom, a multi-stalk variation of the other first new one. Choose between dig spots. Fixed dirt on the boulder cave in fall.
